facts.statement: Corvina SOW-2 has a target start date of 12 October and a value of €74k.
facts.whyItMatters: The target start date and deal value need to be verified against the finalized SOW.

facts.statement: Bhavin plans to send the SOW along with a heads-up email regarding Kriti and SyncRiver.
facts.quote: Corvina: Bhavin "just sending the SOW + a heads-up email about Kriti and SyncRiver".
facts.whyItMatters: Adding sub-processors and project personnel must comply with the notice provisions under the existing DPA.

facts.statement: Deal SYN-120 covers SOW-2 and sub-processor notice for EUR 74k starting 12 Oct, adding Kriti and SyncRiver.
facts.quote: SYN-120 (SOW-2 + sub-processor notice): EUR 74k. start 12 Oct. adds Kriti + SyncRiver
facts.whyItMatters: Adding SyncRiver as a sub-processor requires formal sub-processor notification pursuant to GDPR Article 28.
